new_blocker.name: v5_top_level_state_version_breaks_stable_runtime_contract
new_blocker.detail: The v5 candidate proposed conversation-state top-level version 3, while exact stable_runtime_state.py requires CONVERSATION_STATE_VERSION=2 and rejects any other version as STABLE_CONVERSATION_STATE_INVALID.

v6_fix_direction.budget_eviction: drop oldest replay payload but retain request fingerprint so an exact retry fails closed instead of replanning

proved: v5 top-level version 3 is incompatible with exact stable-runtime version 2
top-level version 2 with nested replay fields survives stable-runtime migration copy semantics exactly
legacy version-2 entries without replay_schema_version are marked fail-closed per entry
nested replay schema survives process restart with identical call_id
oversized replay fails before disk publication
aggregate replay budget evicts only the oldest payload while retaining its request fingerprint

limitations: Real current Codex CLI acceptance of identity-free SSE comment keepalives remains unproven because no local codex binary is available.
Candidate is not product-applied; the full exact server suite is still required before mutating PR #8.
